messages:
Alex W: Quick sync — Prospect (prewide) wants to start a 3-week POC. Requirements: SSO (SAML, Okta), SCIM group push + membership sync, per-team RBAC (admin/editor/viewer), and domain allowlist for tenant isolation. They also asked for Hosted pricing vs Dedicated reserved pricing for ~50 req/s steady, with burst to 200. Can owners for each piece pls?
Riley S: I can take SAML + SCIM config and test plan. Need their IdP metadata (entityID, ACS url) and SCIM base URL + auth method. Also want to confirm SCIM supports PATCH for group updates.
Alex W: I'll get IdP metadata today. They said Okta, so should be straightforward. Also they want a sample SCIM payload for group push to show their IdP.
Riley S: Will draft sample SCIM POST/PATCH bodies. Quick note: our SCIM currently supports bulk group create + PATCH for membership; TTL for group caching is 5m by default. If they need faster than 1m, we should flag.
Morgan K: Heads-up on security questionnaire items: they asked about SAML certificate rotation, SCIM auth (we support OAuth bearer tokens for SCIM endpoints), audit logs for provisioning events, and ability to restrict SCIM source IPs.
Alex W: Can we provide an excerpt for the questionnaire about cert rotation and audit logs? They want it in the next 48h.
Jen L: I can draft the legal/security answer snippets for rotation and logs. Need confirmation from Morgan on retention window for provisioning logs and if we publish rotation cadence.
Morgan K: Retention: provisioning/audit logs kept 365 days in hosted. Rotation: we support manual cert rotate via Console + API; recommend 90-day rotation for IdP certs but we don't enforce. Will add note about notification hooks (webhooks/tracing) for rotation events.
Sam P: Pricing: For 50 req/s steady with 2s avg response length we should model per-token cost + throughput. Quick thought: Hosted will likely be cheaper short-term; Dedicated reserved becomes attractive if they commit 3-6 months and need consistent latency/SLA. Riley, can you capture expected tokens/req so I can run numbers?
Riley S: I'll ask them for typical prompt + response sizes. For now assume 100 tokens in + 400 tokens out per request.
Alex W: They're going to confirm payload size by EOD. Also asked about feature gating — they need RBAC that maps to SAML groups (map Okta groups -> Redwood roles). Is mapping supported?
Riley S: Yes — we support group-to-role mapping in Console. You can map Okta group names to Redwood roles and set defaults. We support multiple group claims, too. Will include a short example:```json
{
  "groupMappings": [
    {"oktaGroup":"prewide-admins","redwoodRole":"admin"},
    {"oktaGroup":"prewide-devs","redwoodRole":"editor"}
  ]
}
```
Alex W: Perfect. They also want domain allowlist for tenant isolation (only accept requests from specific customer domains / SSO domains). Any blockers?
Morgan K: We support domain allowlist for account creation + enforcement on hosted. For SCIM we can restrict accepted bearer token scopes to particular tenant IDs. If they need IP allowlist for SCIM we can do it via customer-managed VPC for Private or Dedicated.
Jen L: Add note: if they request inbound IP allowlist for an on-prem endpoint, we need an SOC/infra review. Might add 1-2 weeks to timeline.
Sam P: Action items summary: Riley = SAML/SCIM test plan + sample payloads; Morgan = security questionnaire answers (rotation, logs, retention, IP controls); Jen = legal/wording for questionnaire; Alex = collect IdP metadata + token size; Sam = pricing scenarios after token numbers. Timeline: draft answers + docs by Friday EOD, POC kickoff next Mon if customer ready.
Alex W: Sounds good. @infra-bot please create a POC ticket with owner tags for SAML/SCIM/RBAC/security/pricing.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4728: "prewide POC - auth + provisioning" assigned to Riley S, Morgan K. Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-4728
Riley S: I'll post the SAML ACS/Entity ID template and SCIM sample later today in this thread.
Morgan K: I'll start drafting the security answers — will ping for any clarifications.
Alex W: Thanks all — will update once I have IdP metadata from customer. :thumbsup:
